description: Proof of concept (v0). Adds an Advanced City Builder tool to Town > Tools: place a town with slider-controlled residential, commercial and industrial sizes (maximum configurable up to 200% of normal), an initial road angle range, a capacity scaling factor, and one cargo need per district (None, Random or a specific cargo).
name: Advanced City Builder (v0)
summary: Town placement tool with per-district sizes, road angles and cargo needs.
